sn21.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn21.1:1.3: Tatra kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn21.1:1.5: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahā-Moggallānassa paccassosuṃ || || 3
sn21.1:2.2: Idha mayhaṃ āvuso rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn21.1:2.3: Ariyo tuṇhībhāvo ariyo tuṇhībhāvo ti vuccati || ||
sn21.1:2.4: Katamo nu kho ariyo tuṇhībhāvo ti || || 4
sn21.1:2.6: Idha bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattam sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkam avicāraṃ samādhijam pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati || ||
sn21.1:2.8: So khvāham āvuso vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvam avitakkam avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn21.1:2.9: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato vitakkasahagatā saññā manasikārā samudācaranti || || 6
sn21.1:3.1: Atha kho mam āvuso Bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca || ||
sn21.1:3.2: Moggallāna Moggallāna mā brāhmaṇa ariyaṃ tuṇhībhāvam pamādo || Ariye tuṇhībhāve cittaṃ saṇṭhāpehi || ariye tuṇhibhāve cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi || ariye tuṇhibhāve cittaṃ samādahāti || || 7
sn21.1:3.3: So khvāham āvuso aparena samayena vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvam avitakkam avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn21.1:3.4: Yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammāvadamāno vadeyya || ||
sn21.1:3.5: Satthārā anuggahito sāvako mahābhiññatam patto ti || mamantaṃ sammāvadamāno vadeyya
sn21.1:3.6: satthārā anuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ patto ti || ||
